name: This Dream of Hours
source:
Miriam returns from her long apprenticeship in Arizona to find things have changed in the small magical town of Ninebark, Pennsylvania. 

Miriam's father is engaged to a ghost, her ex-boyfriend, the Phantom (yes, [i]that[/i] Phantom), is singing at the Winter Ball and the ball itself proves to be a disaster because the elf prince's chosen Cinderella has gone missing, and if she isn't found in 72 hours, the town of Ninebark will cease to exist. 

Meanwhile, the Kill All Humans Society is running the Death Cap Festival and doesn't care if hapless mortals stumble in.

Can Miriam prove her ability, stop the Kill All Humans faction, find love [i]and[/i] the missing Cinderella before it's too late? 

[From [url=https://sunlabyrinth.itch.io/this-dream-of-hours]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
米里亚姆结束了在亚利桑那州的长期学徒生涯，回来后发现宾夕法尼亚州尼纳巴克这个神奇的小镇发生了变化。

米里亚姆的父亲与鬼魂订婚，她的前男友幻影（是的，[i]那个[/i]幻影）正在冬季舞会上唱歌，而舞会本身却被证明是一场灾难，因为精灵王子选择的灰姑娘失踪了，如果72小时内找不到她，尼恩巴克镇将不复存在。

与此同时，杀戮全人类协会正在举办死亡帽子节，他们并不关心是否会有倒霉的凡人跌倒。

米里亚姆能否证明自己的能力，阻止杀死所有人类派系，并在为时已晚之前找到爱[i]和[/i]失踪的灰姑娘？

[来自[url=https://sunlabyrinth.itch.io/this-dream-of-hours]itch.io[/url]]
